item.title: [ 34] Trump’s powerful new friends are making MAGA uncomfortable
item.description:
https://thehill.com/homenews/administration/6124669-trump-xi-mamdani-gop-concerns/

President Trump’s appearances with Chinese President Xi Jinping, New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani (D) and leaders from Silicon Valley risk turning off his political base just as Republicans are seeking to turbocharge turnout ahead of the midterms, say GOP strategists.

The president has always loved meeting with the powerful, even if they are dictators or democratic socialists, as it makes headlines and highlights his own stature.

Trump was the first president to meet with North Korea leader Kim Jong Un, and he met with Russian President Vladimir Putin last year. He had a memorable buddy-buddy term in the Oval Office with Mamdani last November, even as his party sought to vilify the liberal mayor.

To many Republicans, the latest meetings are a danger.

“Frankly, it’s inexplicable,” one unnamed Republican strategist said. “Not because as president you shouldn’t meet with the Chinese president or event the mayor of New York, but given their toxicity with the base that you were desperate to try to turnout at higher than normal levels to try and offset your vulnerabilities with every other layer of the November turnout populace.”

“You need to fire up your base and instead you’re kind of deflating them in the homestretch,” the strategist added.

Trump hosted his Chinese counterpart last week for a lavish state visit at the White House. That meeting came after Mamdani hosted Trump at Gracie Mansion in New York City.

On Tuesday, Trump invited several tech leaders to the White House for a luncheon on artificial intelligence before appearing with them on the White House North Lawn for an impromptu news conference.

Polling shows that the president’s base views China with skepticism.

item.title: [ 71] Games with Friends aka Friendslop
item.description:
Ever since there was that recent controversy over Steam refunds I've been thinking about how copy and paste this genre really is. Easy objectives so you can focus more on hanging out. Proximity chat. Chaotic gameplay loops. These games are essentially clip factories: simple enough for anyone to jump in, cheap enough for whole friend groups to buy on impulse, and engineered so the funniest moments come from player interactions rather than deep systems. And it's like a race to see who gets picked up by a big content creator first since that's essentially your big break.
On the flip side, with so many things competing for your attention now, I can understand the appeal of people just wanting something that is quick and easy, that they don't have to spend hours teaching someone else, and that they can generally have a good time in. I think people focus a lot on the quirky-looking titles, but there seems to be more variety to this pool of games if you take the time to dive in.

Is it a bad thing to have friends in video games?

item.title: [ 45] Europe is not poorer than the USA
item.description:
I see many Americans who like to brag about how they are much richer than we are in Europe but they make a number of fallacies.

1. The ignore that in Europe many services are free or heavily subsidised. Not only healthcare but also transportation, education, childcare, and even food.

2. They ignore that in Europe the price of goods in general is cheaper. Only consumer electronics are the same price but everything else is cheaper. The PPP of a Euro against a Dollar is much stronger for the Euro. When PPP is considered accurately, it is clear that European salaries are equal or above the USA salaries ontop of the superior socialised services.

3. They ignore wealth outside of personal monetary wealth. Things like being able to walk outside in a beautiful historic city or enjoy peaceful nature a short cycle from my home. Living in the heart of a friendly society and not being trapped in a suburban prison.

There are more reasons also but these are the most significant ones in my opinion.

item.title: [ 59] Cheap generic table salt contains toxic cyanide as an anti-caking agent
item.description:
They call it "Yellow Prussiate of Soda" but it is just a fancy name for "Sodium ferrocyanide". I noticed that only the cheapest generic brands of table salt use this. The quality name brands like Morton instead use benign Calcium Silicate as its anti-caking ingredient.

Its not like salt is really very expensive either way. But the generic stuff is somewhat cheaper, but its not really a big deal either way in my opinion. But this is what you end up getting in exchange for that marginally cheaper price.

If you look that stuff up in the wikipedia article it says it is particularly damaging to your kidneys. But government regulators say its "okay" because not much of it is being used. Well, I don't know about that. I'd prefer to keep my kidneys in good working order, thank you very much.

Just pay like $1 more for the good salt. Its a small price to pay to not end up having kidney failure later in life and having to go through dialysis or whatever.

item.description:
https://www.foxnews.com/politics/aocs-dramatic-retelling-cornell-rape-allegations-collides-complaint-details
Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, D-N.Y., painted a far more sweeping picture of a Cornell University sexual assault case than what's alleged in the underlying civil complaint, while also making claims the university disputes.

Speaking during a town hall hosted by More Perfect University on Sunday in Ithaca, New York, Ocasio-Cortez addressed allegations outlined in a civil complaint filed last month by a former Cornell student identified as Jane Doe, who alleges she was drugged and sexually assaulted by multiple fraternity members in October 2024.

"Seven men drugged and gang raped a 20-year-old woman," Ocasio-Cortez said.

"They lured her in to a fraternity house," she continued. "They drugged her with ketamine. They then posted to a group chat that she was incapacitated, and seven men took turns gang raping her for seven hours."
"Their fraternity knew. This was reported to Cornell University. And after looking into this matter, they expelled two of them and made the rest write essays as their form of punishment," Ocasio-Cortez said. "I want to be clear that the culture of rape, sexual assault, and pedophilia is protected in elite institutions across the United States and including Cornell University in this instance. It has got to stop."

Cornell has disputed Ocasio-Cortez's characterization of the disciplinary action, saying expulsions and suspensions were issued and that no respondent was required to write an essay as the sole consequence. The civil complaint alleges that several students who received temporary suspensions were given an opportunity to mitigate their conduct by submitting essays to the university.

item.title: [ 83] MAGA senator suffers embarrassing blunder while trying to defame Jack Smith in hearing
item.description:
Right Wing Law: Every accusation they make is a confession

https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/congress/senator-eric-schmitt-jack-smith-basketball-perjury-rcna600546

His slam dunk was a brick.

Sen. Eric Schmitt, R-Mo., accused former special counsel Jack Smith on Tuesday of committing perjury when he denied having attended a specific Atlanta Hawks basketball game in 2024 — to Smith’s apparent confusion.

The attempted trick play happened during a Senate Judiciary Committee hearing on Smith’s now-scuttled investigations into President Donald Trump. But it soon emerged that Schmitt had the wrong team.

“Did you go to an NBA game between the Golden State Warriors and the Atlanta Hawks on Feb. 3, 2024?” Schmitt asked.

“What city would that be in?” a confused-looking Smith replied.

“Atlanta,” Schmitt responded.

“No,” Smith responded.

Schmitt pressed him again about whether he was in Atlanta on that date and then said he’d give him some “context” — it was the day after Fani Willis, the district attorney of Fulton County, Georgia, “came clean” about her romantic relationship with a prosecutor in her then-pending criminal case against Trump.

“The next day were you in Atlanta?” Schmitt continued.

“I do not believe so,” Smith responded. “I definitely did not go to a Hawks game. I’m sure of that.”
Schmitt then asked whether he ever met with the local prosecutors in Atlanta who charged Trump. “No,” Smith said.

“What would you say if I had a series of text messages from your team that said you were in Atlanta, at a Warrior-Hawks game, on Feb. 3, 2024, the day after Willis and [Nathan] Wade announced their affair?” Schmitt continued as a staffer held up a poster board that had three text messages about Smith’s going to an event.

The staffer quickly took the poster down as Smith looked on, appearing confused.

“I don’t think you know that we have this stuff, so I’ll give you a second to process it so you don’t perjure yourself,” Schmitt said.

item.title: [ 37] I posted this thread on the travel board, but I thought maybe you guys would be
item.description:
I posted this thread on the travel board, but I thought maybe you guys would be able to give me some advice too...

So this is gonna sound really stupid and crazy, but I'm so fucking miserable and I just hate my life and I'm so bored all the time just tired of everything. And I'm out of shape, and I'm really stupid and worthless. I can't take care of myself. I'm addicted to self destruction and I want to change so bad. I want to do something really dramatic, something that will shock my whole nervous system into survival mode so I can find God and become the Man I know I can be.

Sorry this is really melodramatic and unhinged, I'm kinda cringe. But I want to walk.. like from my house all the way to Alaska. I just want to walk there. I'm broke, I have no car and very little money. But I figure I could just walk there, and start a new life.

I know it would be hard. I have about $3000 in savings and I would probably need that mostly for food and stuff along the way. I might have to figure out news ways of making money on the way. I'd need to figure out all kinds of things.

What I'm most worried about is freezing to death in my sleep and encountering territorial wild animals somewhere. Besides that I also worry about being robbed or murdered by other humans.

This is sort of a radical question, so I'd appreciate any and all opinions / advice / suggestions things I should learn / read / buy before I go. Or on the way. I know this is probably stupid but please try to keep an open mind..

item.title: [143] NYC 7 DAY ITINERARY
item.description:
>Mon — Times Square. Top of the Rock. Dinner at Bubba Gump.

>Tue — Statue of Liberty ferry. Little Italy lunch. Dinner at Carmine's.

>Wed — Empire State Building. Macy's Herald Square. Dinner at Tao. 169 Bar.

>Thu — 9/11 Memorial. Charging Bull photo. Lexington Candy Shop (This 97 year old diner still serves their Coke the old-fashioned way). Dinner at Eataly.

>Fri — SoHo shopping. Magnolia Bakery. Katz's dinner. Times Square The Basement rave

>Sat — Brooklyn Bridge walk at noon. DUMBO photos. 9/11 memorial. Dinner at Lombardi's. Times Square.

>Sun — Central Park horse carriage. Brunch at Sarabeth's. Broadway matinee. Charging bull photo.

>Mon – Check-out. Final pilgrimage with my luggage to Lexington & 125th cause of the velvet underground song. Blacklane ride to JFK.

My idea is to have a good time and make it an unforgettable experience at the city that never sleeps. Something that will change me forever.

item.title: [228] Freediving / Spearfishing
item.description:
General thread for freediving and/or spearfishing, since I don't see one mentioning either.

My personal questions:
I've been thinking about taking a certification course so I can learn to do these things correctly and safely. I'm probably happy just doing the diving, but spearfishing seems like an easy and practical extension. I only casually skindive and rod-and-reel fish at the moment. Does anyone have experience taking such a course?
I know I'll need my own gear early on, but each instructor I can find seems to have their own equipment shops, so I imagine they wouldn't be impartial about the quality of other gear on the market. I live on the Pacific coast of the US, so I see that a 7 mm open cell wetsuit is strongly recommended. What good/bad features should I look out for on wetsuits and other equipment? For non-competitive diving, carbon fiber fins are almost certainly not worth the price, right?
